text:
Anna M: Quick ping — scheduling next Platform Standards sync (architecture review style) on Tue 10/12 11am PT. We have two guest reviewer slots for a benchmarking walkthrough and a batching policy change. Can folks claim? Add pre-reads to the agenda doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/platform-standards/agenda

Devin K: I can take one guest reviewer slot. Will prepare a 5-minute benchmarking summary with perf graphs and steps to reproduce.

Priya S: Claiming slot 2 to walk through the batching policy changes and expected impact. I'll include the config diffs and a short rollout plan. cc @Liam G for infra notes.

Liam G: Adding a tiny prep checklist here so everyone has a common baseline:
```
- 1 slide TL;DR + decision asked
- link to benchmark artifacts (logs, harness)
- brief risk matrix + rollback steps
- short test plan and owners
```
I'll paste this into the agenda doc.

Anna M: Rotating facilitator note — Priya S would you run the meeting next week? After that Devin K will be facilitator. I'm proposing a 25m main meeting + 10m overflow. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya S: Yep, I can facilitate. 25m main + 10m overflow sounds good. I'll run the lightning timer.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: calendar event requires attendee list and any security review links 48h before meeting. Please update the event.

Devin K: Small operational ask — can someone tag RFCs in the agenda doc with "priority" if they need explicit board input? I can triage them once tagged.

Sarah L: I'll add RFC-2026 and RFC-2031 with short read-aheads and link to perf harness: https://stash.internal/benchmarks/runner

Anna M: Draft agenda (compact):
1) Roll call + facilitator announce (1m)
2) Guest reviewer 1 — benchmarking + ask (6m)
3) Guest reviewer 2 — batching policy + ask (6m)
4) RFC lightning triage (8m)
5) Actions & owner assign (4m)
(overflow 10m)

Please upload pre-reads by EOD Friday. React with :raised_hands: to claim a slot.

Devin K: :raised_hands:

Priya S: :raised_hands:

Liam G: I'll upload infra notes and a short script of commands I used tonight.

Anna M: Thanks all — I'll update the calendar and copy the checklist into the meeting doc. Facilitator template for quick paste:
```
- start meeting and state timebox
- run 5/6/8 minute timers per presenter
- capture decisions directly in the doc
- confirm owners and follow-ups before close
```
See you all there.
